channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about KC Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about KC Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge, KC Jones
item.description:
Stevens:

“We hear stories about his teams occasionally. I work for a guy who was a part of those teams, so, yeah, we hear about those teams. More importantly, Danny (Ainge) just left my office telling KC Jones stories. It's a tough day.”

Brad Stevens on Danny Ainge, KC Jones, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Danny Ainge on KC Jones
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Danny Ainge on KC Jones:

“He was just a real guy. ... He did a fantastic job of coaching, but more than that he was a friend and mentorand he really cared deeply about us as people.”

Danny Ainge on KC Jones, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Danny Ainge on KC Jones
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Danny Ainge on playing for KC Jones:

“KC was a great coach to play for. ... He had this competitive edge that was fierce.... But he had this gentleness and kindness. At the right time he knew what to say. He was a great leader of men.”

Danny Ainge on KC Jones, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.
